summary: Tested async resume screening fix for large batches (20 resumes) across backend and frontend on public URL. Verified start endpoint quick response, status polling to completion, in-progress endpoint behavior (409), results transition, and legacy synchronous analyze regression.
action_items: No functional defects reproduced for requested async large-batch screening scope.
Optional maintainability: split /app/backend/server.py (>1800 LOC) into modular services/routes.
critical_code_review_comments: No blocking API/UI defect found in requested flows.
Single large backend module increases regression risk and slows RCA for future async-processing incidents.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Added 2 new backend regression tests: quick async start response and processing->409 then completion->200 checks for results/analytics/export on 20-resume batch. UI e2e confirmed upload -> processing -> auto results transition for both 2-resume and 20-resume ZIP flows.
rca of the issue: Original user symptom (stuck after Start Resume Screening for 20+ resumes with unable to process files) was not reproducible in this environment. Async start+polling flow completed successfully for 20 resumes and surfaced results without timeout.
